description: This file defines a template class TlsEnabled that provides TLS configuration and setup for WebSocket clients, including certificate handling, TLS context initialization, and verification logic.

classes.name: TlsEnabled
classes.description: A template class providing TLS setup, certificate loading, and verification for WebSocket connections.

methods.name: setCertFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename for the client certificate.

methods.name: setKeyFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename for the private key.

methods.name: setCAFileNames
methods.description: Sets the list of CA certificate file paths.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the TLS setup for the derived class's endpoint.

methods.name: addProtocolToAddress
methods.description: Prepends 'wss://' to the given address to form a WebSocket Secure URL.

methods.name: setAuthenticationState
methods.description: Sets whether TLS authentication succeeded based on connection error codes.

methods.name: onTlsInit
methods.description: Creates and configures a new SSL context for TLS handshake with specified protocols and certificates.

methods.name: loadCertificateAuthorities
methods.description: Loads CA certificates into the SSL context from specified files or defaults.
